Follow the `resolve-pr-feedback` skill in this repository
(`skills/resolve-pr-feedback/SKILL.md`).

`${input:context}` may name the PR or add context. Then:

- Collect every review comment into a single checklist.
- Address each one test-first, or reply with clear reasoning if you disagree.
- Re-verify, then resolve threads honestly.
